units.source_text: 家将逢到这些死尸的腐烂的臭气，不由的掩了鼻子。

en.t: The servant came upon the rotting stench of these corpses and instinctively covered his nose.

units.source_text: 然而那手，在其次的一刹那间，便忘却了掩住鼻子的事了。

en.t: Yet in the very next instant, that hand forgot all about covering his nose.

units.source_text: 因为有一种强烈的感情，几乎全夺去了这人的嗅觉了。

en.t: For a powerful emotion had almost completely robbed the man of his sense of smell.
